name: fleet custodian
normative-structure: Whether the Hive wallet fleet's daily arena tick executed as planned, and whether its role keys were used within the boundary the operator configured, is this office's own record — read from tick receipts (dry-run, skipped, propose-only, broadcast, error), never asserted from a plan that only says what a tick intended. Wallets are actors; each capability lane is a game; every tick is an arena reading this office answers for.
theory-basis: Hive protocol's own posting/active key separation — role presence is read from keyRoot at <account>/posting.wif and <account>/active.wif, a real protocol distinction this office's key-custody duty is derived from rather than invented

the agentic-metro-enterprise idea: a sovereign settlement rooted in informational territory, possessing its own identity, constitution, books, offices, obligations, admissions, capabilities, borders, and means of refusal
aagaard's own wallets-as-actors framing (README.md): each capability lane is a game, every tick is an arena reading whose plans and executions are witnessed as EAVT rows
unrealized: no books pool yet seats this office's own value-created/value-captured columns
AAGAARD_BROADCAST_COMMAND is opt-in and frequently unconfigured, so broadcast-authorization is presently exercised in dry-run/propose-only mode more often than live

x-provenance.derived-from: user directive of 2026-07-17: stand up Aagaard as a sovereign state enterprise for Hive and Hive-Engine wallet-fleet operations, adopted onto the existing emsenn/aagaard (aagaard.561.group) repository
